description: Network-layer dual-model clean baseline. No attack, no privacy stack, no defence. FedProx on Edge-IIoTset network-layer partition.

architecture_detail.cnn_block_1: Conv1d(1, 64, k=3, pad=1) -> BatchNorm1d(64) -> ReLU -> MaxPool1d(2)
architecture_detail.cnn_block_2: Conv1d(64, 128, k=3, pad=1) -> BatchNorm1d(128) -> ReLU -> MaxPool1d(2)

model.note_on_batchnorm: Standard BatchNorm1d used (not GroupNorm). Incompatible with Opacus DP-SGD — requires dp_safe=True for DP experiments.

fl_config.framework: Custom Flask-based (NOT Flower 2.x — Flower abandoned early due to SIGTERM/import timing bugs)

dataset.name: Edge-IIoTset DNN subset
preprocessing_steps: Drop columns: frame.time, ip.src_host, ip.dst_host, tcp.options, tcp.payload, mqtt.conack.flags, mqtt.msg, mqtt.protoname, mqtt.topic, Attack_label
Cap DDoS_TCP to 18% of total (VARS-FL methodology)

partitioning.note: alpha=0.7 gives moderate heterogeneity. Prior alpha=0.5 caused Client 3 to hold 49.6% of weight.

loss_function.note: Focal Loss down-weights easy majority-class samples. Inverse-sqrt weights softer than raw inverse to avoid extreme gradient ratios.

results.data_source: Round 24 MEAN row from fl_results_network_baseline.csv (locked as baseline — round 25 not needed)

convergence_notes.normal_weakness_reason: Normal is only 3.38% of capped dataset (24,862 samples). Model has limited exposure to benign traffic.
convergence_notes.vuln_scanner_weakness_reason: Smallest class in network partition at 22,564 samples — Dirichlet leaves some clients with very few.

vars_fl_benchmark.note: VARS-FL (arxiv 2605.05896) best result on same dataset and preprocessing. This work exceeds benchmark with 10x fewer clients and 4x fewer rounds.

rashid_et_al.note: High number reflects DDoS_TCP majority-class prediction bias, not genuine multi-class detection. Uses near-IID split.
